components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single high-commitment action, signaled as an AI-assisted decision.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { appearance: none; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #E0FF20 0%, #FFFF00 100%); color: #17310F; font: 600 14px/1.2 'Overused Grotesk', Inter, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #294719; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A calm alternative action that preserves the main CTA's authority.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { appearance: none; border: 1px solid #CCD6C4; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #182014; font: 500 14px/1.2 'Overused Grotesk', Inter, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F1F5EC; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #E4E9DF; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #294719; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Operational Card
components.description: A restrained module for a discrete field decision or editable dashboard widget.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid #E4E9DF; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #182014; font: 400 14px/1.45 'Overused Grotesk', Inter, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-card strong { display: block; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card p { margin: 6px 0 0; color: #596452; }

components.name: AI Evidence Badge
components.description: A compact marker for AI-supported insight or evidence context.
components.css: .ds-badge-ai { display: inline-block; border: 1px solid #6B8547; border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px 8px; background: #F7FFD2; color: #17310F; font: 600 12px/1.2 'Overused Grotesk', Inter, Arial, sans-serif; }

components.name: Field Input
components.description: An explicit, touch-friendly field for editable farm inputs.

components.css: .ds-trace { border: 1px solid #E4E9DF; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #182014; font: 500 13px/1.35 'Overused Grotesk', Inter, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-trace summary { cursor: pointer; list-style: none; } .ds-trace summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-trace i { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; margin-right: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #2F7BC4; } .ds-trace em { margin-left: 6px; color: #6B8547; font-style: normal; } .ds-trace p { margin: 8px 0 0 14px; color: #596452; font-weight: 400; } .ds-trace:focus-within { outline: 2px solid rgba(107, 133, 71, 0.16); outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview: AgriSense is a calm operational workspace, not a futuristic agriculture dashboard. It pairs paper-light surfaces and deep plant greens with a single vivid lime signal for AI assistance, so field decisions feel practical, traceable, and immediately actionable. The UI is Bengali-first, mobile-first, icon- and number-forward, and deliberately legible for low-literacy-tolerant use.

rules.name: Evidence-in-the-Interface Rule
rules.body: Do not present a recommendation or a consequential number as an unexplained assertion. Make its source, method, or trace reachable in the same working context.

rules.name: One Lime Rule
rules.body: AI Lime is reserved for AI/highlight emphasis and the primary-gradient family.

rules.name: Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Use surface contrast and borders to group information. Reserve elevation for floating, transient, or directly manipulated controls.

dos: Do use the AgriSense semantic tokens and light-dark() pairs rather than hard-coded per-screen colors.
Do use Overused Grotesk throughout and preserve tabular figures for money, dates, and quantities.
Do keep the AI Lime gradient for the primary CTA and AI/highlight family.
Do make source, trace, and state visible near decisions that affect a field plan or money.
donts: Don't turn the interface into a generic analytics dashboard with decorative charts, excessive shadows, or a rainbow status palette.
Don't use raw hex values or create a second visual token system in individual screens.
Don't use lime as a general decoration or as a substitute for semantic status.
Don't present model-invented figures or recommendations without their deterministic, live, or cited basis.
